profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished software developer with 17 years of experience developing and operating large scale software test automation systems for world class software. Four years of managing an agile development team to build testing tools and data management systems. Extensive knowledge with large databases, data warehousing, client/server distributed workflows systems and Internet development platforms (HTML/XAML). Strong team leader and proven individual contributor developing tools and test frameworks using .NET, C#, C++, Visual Basic, JScript, Perl and SQL. Interested in software development and leadership roles with early stage start-ups as well as established companies.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Content Quality Assessment team member where I built tools and reports to measure the quality of the automated tests for Windows and Internet Explorer.  Developed a process that pragmatically identifies low value automated tests (unreliable or redundant).  Using this process I successfully reduce IE’s automated tests without loss of test coverage. Resulted in significant time saving for test execution and result analysis. 

Internet Explorer Security Response team member managing IE’s test execution system and result analysis for SSRIPs and monthly security updates.

positions.title: Software Development Lead 2
positions.description: Lead an agile team of software developers to build and operate the automation tools and infrastructure used for Internet Explorer.  Created team vision and project plans, used scrum/sprints to build a wide range of tools, processes and reports. My team developed IE’s workflow scheduling and virtual machine provisioning systems enabling the first use of virtual machines for the automated testing of Internet Explorer.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test 2
positions.description: Built and managed the Internet Explorer’s website compatibility measuring system. Developed the system end to end including the data warehouse, replicated SQL server configuration, data collection tools, and reporting system. I participated in the hiring and training of a team of 50 vendors in three countries to collect website compatibility data for IE, Chrome, Firefox and Safari. The system provided the data for the IE Compatibility View List feature which improves the user experience in top website. Intern coach for two summer interns.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: On assignment at Microsoft for the Internet Explorer team operating the IE test lab.  Maintained all testing infrastructure including test hardware (PCs, laptops, accessories), servers, proxy servers, web servers, SQL Servers, network switches, D-Taps.  Schedule all automated test runs and maintained testing schedule. Created custom network topologies, built tools and reports using HTML, JScript, and Visual Basic. Created specialized testing libraries and tools to automate testing Microsoft's HTML platform and Internet Explorer applications shell.

positions.title: Information System Engineer
positions.description: Information Systems Engineer for a INC 500 company with 100+ user Microsoft Windows NT Network. Maintained all user and e-mail accounts, system policies, and data backups. Serviced and installed hardware including workstations, servers, network switches, printers and fax machines. Upgraded email system from Microsoft Mail to Microsoft Exchange server. Maintained public folders, distribution lists, and team calendar. Database application developer for the company's Return Material Authorization application.
